meta.target_context: Cloud not decided; replatform to containers assumed

requirements.title: Claim registration parity
requirements.description: The migrated application shall accept claim submissions with the same inputs and responses as today.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Given an active policy, when a broker submits a claim, then it is stored with status REGISTERED. Given an inactive policy on the loss date, then the claim is rejected (BR-001). Given an amount > 50,000, then it is routed to manual assessment (BR-002).

requirements.title: Migrate CLAIM data
requirements.description: The migration shall move all CLAIM rows with reconciled counts and amounts.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Row count and SUM(AMOUNT) match source and target per STATUS; PII columns encrypted at rest.

requirements.title: FinanceSys export continues
requirements.description: The migrated application shall deliver the assessed-claims file to FinanceSys from the cloud.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: File delivered on schedule (TBD, see CF-001) and accepted by FinanceSys from the new egress IPs.

requirements.title: Availability target
requirements.description: The migrated application shall meet the agreed availability target.

assumptions.assumption: Every production app needs a defined availability target (BASELINE)

open_questions.question: What availability / RPO / RTO does the business need?
